item.title: Why Do We Go to the Gym? Rented Discipline vs. Real Stamina
item.description: Do people go to the gym for lifelong fitness, or just because they paid for it? From an Army-family mindset and Yellow Dude calisthenics to building Kuchh Bhii—my mobile app for daily discipline, strength, and stamina.
item.author: Sughosh P Dixit

item.title: Titan's Horological Revolution: Business Strategy Lessons from Xerxes Desai & JRD Tata
item.description: Reflections on the inspiring journey of Xerxes Desai and JRD Tata in building Titan from scratch into a world-class, affordable Indian watchmaker, and how it transformed the Indian market.
item.author: Sughosh P Dixit

item.title: Stop Defending Hindu Rituals with Pseudoscience
item.description: Why do we feel the need to defend every cultural practice as 'scientific'? In this togglable essay, choose between a relatable layman analysis of societal polarization, Gen-Z laziness, and ritual practices, or a rigorous technical exploration of logical incompleteness, quantum mechanics, and the Hard Problem of consciousness.
item.author: Sughosh P Dixit

item.title: Dr. Vinayak Damodar Savarkar — The Underrated Colossus of Bharat's Freedom Struggle
item.description: I was invited to give a session on Dr. Vinayak Damodar Savarkar — one of the most consequential yet misunderstood figures of Bharat's freedom struggle. With little time to prepare, I bought a detailed book and an Amar Chitra Katha comic on him, read both cover to cover, and here is my take.
item.author: Sughosh P Dixit

item.title: Why Support Liverpool F.C? The Beautiful Game vs The Lazy Game
item.description: Being an ardent Liverpool fan, I can tell you supporting Liverpool is not like supporting any ordinary club—it's a way of life. This is why football, the world's most followed sport, beats cricket every single time. It's time to stop watching the lazy game and embrace the beautiful game.
